stepFields.name: output
stepFields.description: Output body shown under the command.

stepFields.name: language
stepFields.description: Language id for highlighting `output`.

stepFields.name: exitCode
stepFields.description: Process exit code — renders a badge (0 reads success, non-zero danger).

stepFields.name: spinner
stepFields.description: Shows a spinner with this label while the step runs, before `output` lands. For a step that should read as "this takes a while".

stepFields.name: cwd
stepFields.description: Per-entry overrides of the prompt chrome — each independently optional, and each PERSISTS to every following entry until overridden again, mirroring `Terminal`'s own per-entry override semantics (a real shell's `cd`/`ssh` changes the prompt for every command after it, not just that one line). Falls back to the scene-level prop of the same name when never set by any entry up to this point.

fields.name: preset
fields.description: Default "architecture".

fields.name: layout
fields.description: Overrides the preset's default placement strategy.

stepFields.name: reveal
stepFields.description: Node and group ids that appear on this step. Anything never named in any step's `reveal` is present from the first frame.

stepFields.name: connect
stepFields.description: Edge ids whose line draws on this step.

stepFields.name: flow
stepFields.description: Edge ids that carry animated flow tokens for this step's duration — the "watch the request travel" beat.

stepFields.name: focus
stepFields.description: Node ids to spotlight; everything else dims.

stepFields.name: annotate
stepFields.description: Leader-line callouts pinned to nodes.

fields.name: messages
fields.description: Ordered messages and notes. Order is both the vertical stacking order and the reveal order. Activation bars are derived from it.

fields.name: from
fields.description: Participant id the message leaves from.

fields.name: to
fields.description: Participant id it arrives at. Equal to `from` draws a self-call loop.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: Default "sync". Use "data" for a return/reply and "error" for a failure path — that is what makes the diagram readable at a glance.

fields.name: on
fields.description: Participant ids the note attaches to. One anchors it to that lane; two or more span from the leftmost to the rightmost.

fields.name: steps
fields.description: Omit for a single-beat scene that just draws the chart on.

stepFields.name: series
stepFields.description: Series labels revealed on this step. Omitted on every step means the whole chart draws on over the scene's first step.

stepFields.name: callout
stepFields.type: { value: number; label: string; format?: NumberFormat; }
stepFields.description: A number to pull out as a counted-up callout while this step runs.

stepFields.name: focus
stepFields.description: Category label to spotlight — its bar/point/slice stays lit and the rest dim.

fields.name: columns
fields.description: Tiles per row at the widest breakpoint. Default 4.

stepFields.name: value
stepFields.description: Numeric target — counted up from zero.

stepFields.name: text
stepFields.description: Non-numeric value ("Healthy", "us-east-1"). Use instead of `value`.

stepFields.name: delta
stepFields.description: Change against the previous period, signed.

stepFields.name: positiveIsGood
stepFields.description: Whether a positive `delta` should read as good. Default true — set false for metrics like latency or error rate.

stepFields.name: sparkline
stepFields.description: Trend series drawn as an inline sparkline.

fields.name: mode
fields.description: "columns" sets them side by side; "wipe" overlays them under a divider that sweeps across. Default "columns".

fields.name: say
fields.description: Narration for the reveal of `after`.

typeAlias.name: ComparePane

fields.name: frame
fields.description: Chrome drawn around the screenshot. Default "browser".

fields.name: image
fields.description: Image rendered inside the frame — a URL or a data URI.

fields.name: url
fields.description: Address shown in the browser chrome.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Caption for window/phone chrome.

stepFields.name: to
stepFields.description: Where the cursor travels to, in percent of the frame.

stepFields.name: action
stepFields.description: What the cursor does on arrival. Default "none".

stepFields.name: type
stepFields.description: Text typed after the action lands.

stepFields.name: spotlight
stepFields.description: Region to spotlight — everything outside it dims.

stepFields.name: annotate
stepFields.description: Callout pinned at the cursor.

fields.name: cta
fields.description: Closing call to action, e.g. "Subscribe for part 4".
